qualification: experiment, shared machine; guarded Mac timing; probe-enabled; no UI painting
method: 100k TypeScript lines, four authors, 8192 retained records, 100 concurrent edits; one warmup pass and A/B/B/A workload order per measured pass; comparison version blocks before/after/after/before. Nearest-rank p95. Native query time is nested in worker/range time; medians are not additive. Publication runs the real unsuperseded method against real window and snapshot; listener dispatch and DOM painting are excluded. Reply-to-completion is derived from the captured batched message, excluding later serial equality-control requests.
